title: AuroraSMP
description: Aurora's community Minecraft survival server multiplayer (open to the general public)
body:
### 🌿 Aurora — Fan-based Survival with Smart Protections & Custom World

Aurora is a survival server built by and for fans of **Aurora**, focused on community, stability, and full control over your gameplay. Supports both **Java and Bedrock**, enhancing vanilla with carefully designed custom systems.

### 🛡️ Advanced protections

* Claim land via GUI menu with "/prote menu"
* Shapes: cube, sphere, cylinder, and dynamic (*fluid*) selection
* Member and permission management
* Configurable flags: PvP, explosions, fire, fluids and more
* Automatic anti-grief protection
* Chest system: private, public, donation

### 🌍 Fully custom world

* Unique terrain generation and biomes
* Custom structures with loot and enemies
* Exploration-focused progression

![Custom generation and structures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Tig1gypE/images/9a62ea633aa00b6a1cc81fa60e5cd96e8f8ecc96.png)

### 🏡 Community-driven

* Active social environment
* Areas like *Lunar Town* for shared living
* Safe space: no hacks, no toxicity

### 🎨 Extras

* Custom paintings (/imgui)
* Experimental language support: use "/lang en" or "/lang es" (affects system UI only, not player messages)
* Seamless Java & Bedrock experience

![Custom paintings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Tig1gypE/images/c305904ec13bede2ccdc87262afde96d87c4216d.jpeg)

---

### 🔗 Join

**Java (26.1.2+)**
`mc.minecraftaurora.com`

**Bedrock**
`play.minecraftaurora.com`
Port: `19132` (default)
